svg.text: face_sim vs cosine_sim, every configuration and checkpoint, per bucket
one bucket per panel: cosine_sim on the bucket's own range, the same 0.016 span in every panel
Dashed: least-squares fit per bucket; ρ = Pearson correlation of face_sim with cosine_sim, σ = residual sd of cosine_sim around the fit.
Lower panels: one bucket per panel on its own cosine_sim range. Every panel spans the same 0.016, so slopes are comparable across panels.
